name: @equin/plugin-framework-import-map-names
description: The bare-specifier namespaces only a page's import map answers — a browser host (`@browser-host/`), its worker entry (`@browser-host-worker/`) and its starting snapshot (`@browser-host-snapshot/`), served by web-artifacts: external to every artifact build, never an npm package, never resolved by Bun. A leaf with no imports directly under framework (not under web-artifacts, whose closure a child would carry into every composition), so source-digest's closure walk — which a server reaches a lazy `import("@browser-host/…")` through — knows them for free.
